key_findings: HIF-1alpha and TRPV1 mRNA, nucleus pulposus NGF/VEGF/NK1R and serum SP/CGRP were higher in non-contained than contained LDH, and both higher than controls.
Non-contained LDH had a higher residual rate of lumbago and leg pain after endoscopic surgery.
